name: Chagas Cardiomyopathy

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Brazilian Consensus on Chagas Disease Diagnosis

criteria.description: Positive serological tests for Trypanosoma cruzi infection
Echocardiographic evidence of dilated cardiomyopathy with segmental wall motion abnormalities
Electrocardiographic abnormalities including right bundle branch block, left anterior fascicular block, or arrhythmias
Exclusion of other causes of cardiomyopathy

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Positive serology plus at least two major cardiac abnormalities (echocardiographic and ECG findings) with exclusion of other causes
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis relies heavily on serology and cardiac imaging; biopsy is rarely performed.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Right bundle branch block with left anterior fascicular block

common.notes: Includes premature ventricular contractions and ventricular tachycardia
Due to arrhythmias or conduction disturbances

occasional.notes: Secondary to ventricular aneurysms or atrial fibrillation

occasional.symptomName: Conduction blocks other than RBBB and LAFB

rare.symptomName: Aneurysm formation of the left ventricular apex

rare.notes: Due to emboli from cardiac thrombi

laboratory: Positive serology for Trypanosoma cruzi (ELISA, IFA, or hemagglutination tests)
Elevated brain natriuretic peptide (BNP) in heart failure
imaging: Echocardiography showing dilated cardiomyopathy with segmental wall motion abnormalities and apical aneurysm
Cardiac MRI demonstrating fibrosis and ventricular aneurysms
genetic: No direct genetic mutations; disease caused by parasitic infection
other: Electrocardiogram with conduction abnormalities and arrhythmias

distinguishingFeatures: No typical ECG conduction blocks seen in Chagas
Presence of coronary artery disease on angiography
Regional wall motion abnormalities correspond to coronary territories

redFlags: New onset ventricular arrhythmias in endemic patient
Evidence of apical aneurysm on imaging
references: Rassi A Jr, Rassi A, Marin-Neto JA. Chagas disease. Lancet. 2010 Apr 17;375(9723):1388-402.
Bern C. Chagas' Disease. N Engl J Med. 2015 Jul 16;373(5):456-66.
Brazilian Consensus on Chagas Disease Diagnosis and Treatment, 2015.
